annotations.title: Check a folder or archive on this machine

description: Reads a folder, .zip, .tar.gz or .tgz on this machine and lists everything it would run, grouped by when: opening it in an editor, starting an AI agent in it, installing, running and committing. Static analysis only: nothing is run, and the files aren't uploaded anywhere. Use it on a downloaded project, a take-home assignment or a folder someone sent you before opening it, installing it or working in it. node_modules is skipped.

offline.description: Skip the dependency lookups on npm and OSV. Default false.

path.description: Absolute path to the folder or archive (~ is expanded).

time_limit_seconds.description: Seconds to spend reading files (default 60). If it runs out, the report says the check is incomplete and what wasn't read.

name: check_path
title: Check a folder or archive on this machine
